notes.title: Remake Version of Black Dream is Ready to be Released Soon
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_SQcHAIZ5E0;full][/previewyoutube]




Hello everyone.

We are preparing for the [b]<Black Dream Plus>[/b], the totally upgraded version of [b]<Black Dream>[/b].
These are quick previews of additional contents and improvements of the game.








[h2]<Visual Improvements>[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Improved CGs[/h3]
[*] [h3]Improved Gameplay Graphics[/h3]
[*] [h3]Improved Readability of Texts[/h3]
[/list]

[h3]Before[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/bd0e1951ac5ab9d2264841630546ca362677dfcb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/9ed87f25ba5d4aeb8075e81dd2fa6ed87032d58b.png[/img]

[h3]After[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/86a43a2be0314134c14915870d248aa50dfedcd8.png[/img]










[h2]<Gameplay Improvements>[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Upgraded UI[/h3]
[*] [h3]Upgraded Character Portraits[/h3]
[*] [h3]Albums for Collecting and Recollecting Illustrations[/h3]
[/list]

[h3]Before[/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]New System: Powerballs (with Cut-ins)[/h3]
[*] [h3]New System: Instant Explosion[/h3]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h3]Improved Structure[/h3]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/1bd3190d63179a6777083d0180953069e056c831.gif[/img]

[h2]<Others>[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]New CGs[/h3]
[*] [h3]New Minigames[/h3]
[*] [h3]48 In-game Achievements[/h3]
[*] [h3]More Interactions with Characters[/h3]
[*] [h3]Stamps for Summarizing the Play[/h3]
[*] [h3]Advanced Play Experiences[/h3]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/09c531a675b6098abf1f32ab2f2320459b4266c4.gif[/img]






[h3]And there's more…[/h3]








[b]<Black Dream>[/b] will be upgraded to [b]<Black Dream Plus>[/b] in the near future.

Due to the remake, the price of the game will be increased from $4.99 to $8.99.
Of course you will get update for free if you have already purchased the game.

Please look forward to it.

Thank you.
